weighted_dilation_norm_equivalence.sigma_zero_singularity_note: At sigma = 0, sum_{d>=1} d^{-1} = infty and sum_{d>=1} |mu(d)| d^{-1} = infty; as sigma -> 0^+, zeta(1 + 2*sigma) = 1/(2*sigma) + O(1) and zeta(1 + 2*sigma)/zeta(2 + 4*sigma) = 3/(pi^2 * sigma) + O(1), so there is no bounded inverse at sigma = 0, while the transfer is boundedly invertible for every sigma > 0.

grade_interval_energy_and_mellin_bridge.equivalence_statement: (forall eps > 0 exists C_eps < infty forall Y >= 1, int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_a(X)|^2 dX/X <= C_eps Y^eps) <-> (forall sigma in (0, 5/2), ||Q_a||_sigma < infty)
grade_interval_energy_and_mellin_bridge.forward_direction_bound: For sigma in (0, 5/2), choose eps = sigma > 0: int_0^1 |Q_a(X)|^2 X^{-2*sigma} dX/X <= zeta(3)^2 / (5 - 2*sigma) and sum_{k>=0} int_{tau^k}^{tau^{k+1}} |Q_a(X)|^2 X^{-2*sigma} dX/X <= C_sigma / (1 - tau^{-sigma}).
grade_interval_energy_and_mellin_bridge.reverse_direction_bound: For eps in (0, 5) and Y >= 1, set sigma = eps / 2 in (0, 5/2): on X in [Y, tau Y], 1 <= (tau Y / X)^{2*sigma} = tau^eps Y^eps X^{-2*sigma}, so int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_a(X)|^2 dX/X <= tau^eps ||Q_a||_{eps/2}^2 Y^eps.

mellin_identities.rh_equivalence_explanation: By Cauchy-Schwarz on int_0^infty Q_a(X) X^{-z} dX/X with sigma = Re(z)/2 in (0, 5/4) (or Parseval-Plancherel along Re(z) = sigma in (0, 5/2)), finiteness of ||Q_a||_sigma for all sigma in (0, 5/2) forces M[Q_a](z) to be holomorphic throughout 0 < Re(z) < 5/2. Since Gamma(5/4 - z/2) and zeta(1 + 2*z) have no zeros in 0 < Re(z) < 5/2, any off-critical zero rho of zeta(s) with 1/2 < Re(rho) < 1 creates a non-removable pole at z = rho - 1/2 with Re(z) in (0, 1/2) subset (0, 5/2).
mellin_identities.bridge_to_subgate_tc_043a_explanation: Although individual square-dilation shifts X -> X/d^2 and dyadic shifts X -> X/2 correspond to real log-shifts log_tau(d^2) and log_tau(2) that are transcendental over Q (not single elements of A_R), the weighted L^2 norm ||.||_sigma on the full multiplicative group (0, infty) is partitioned by the tau-adic intervals [tau^k, tau^{k+1}) generated by the rational integer grades k in Z subset A_R. Thus the auxiliary dilation operators act on the ambient continuum L^2((0, infty), X^{-2*sigma} dX/X) and transfer the grade-interval energy bound on [Y, tau Y] directly between Q_mu and Q_lambda without ever claiming that log_tau(2) or log_tau(d^2) lies in A_R.

section_5_transition_poisson_summation.even_extension_smoothness_note: Since f(v) = v^{-6} exp(-1/v^2) satisfies lim_{v -> 0^+} v^{-m} exp(-1/v^2) = 0 for all m >= 0, all one-sided derivatives f^{(k)}(0^+) = 0 vanish to infinite order, so the even extension f(-v) = f(v) (f(0) = 0) belongs to the Schwartz class S(R) and Poisson summation holds without boundary jump terms.

attack_A_coprime_euler_series_and_separa.off_critical_pole_non_cancellation_theor: For any hypothetical off-critical zero rho = beta + i*gamma of zeta(s) with 1/2 < beta < 1, at the diagonal pair (u, v) = (rho, conj(rho)) one has Re(2*rho) = Re(2*conj(rho)) = 2*beta > 1 and u + v = 2*beta > 1. Because zeta(w) has an absolutely convergent nonvanishing Euler product on Re(w) > 1 (with |zeta(2*rho)| >= zeta(4*beta)/zeta(2*beta) > 0 and zeta(2*beta) > 1), neither the numerator zeta(2u) zeta(2v) nor the coprimality factor 1/zeta(u+v) can vanish at (rho, conj(rho)) to cancel the off-critical poles of 1/(zeta(u) zeta(v)).

replacement_theorem_global_super_polynom.theorem_statement: For every D > 0, the full grade-interval L^2 energy of Q_lambda(X) satisfies the unconditional global super-polynomial logarithmic saving int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_lambda(X)|^2 dX/X << Y exp(-2 c_1 (log Y)^{3/5} (log log Y)^{-1/5}) <<_D Y (log Y)^{-D} for all Y >= 2 (beating the unsigned O(Y) benchmark by every power of log Y).
replacement_theorem_global_super_polynom.proof_mechanism: Retaining the exact separable Gaussian kernel exp(-X^2 (r^{-2} + s^{-2}) / d^2) = exp(-X^2 / (d^2 r^2)) exp(-X^2 / (d^2 s^2)) and expanding 1_{gcd(r,s)=1} = sum_{e | gcd(r,s)} mu(e) with r = e m, s = e n decouples every rectangular block B_{A,B}(X) into products of 1D unweighted Liouville Gaussian sums U_lambda(X/(d e); A/e) U_lambda(X/(d e); B/e) weighted by mu(e)/e and 1/d. Crucially, because m and n carry NO coprimality side condition to d*e, partial summation on L_lambda(x) = sum_{m <= x} lambda(m) = O(x exp(-c_0 Phi(x))) (Korobov-Vinogradov-Walfisz) applies with O(1) Gaussian total variation at EVERY scale (including the transition A, B ~ X), while the divisor sums converge absolutely as sum_{e>=1} e^{-2} = pi^2/6 and sum_{d>=1} d^{-2} = pi^2/6.
replacement_theorem_global_super_polynom.remaining_barrier_to_subgate_tc_043a: While the separable Gaussian decoupling eliminates the transition Euler-Maclaurin barrier and improves the global energy bound from O(Y) to O(Y exp(-2 c_1 (log Y)^{3/5} (log log Y)^{-1/5})), closing SUBGATE-TC-043A requires int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_lambda(X)|^2 dX/X <= C_eps Y^eps (a power saving of exponent nearly 1 over O(Y)), which via Mellin inversion requires a zero-free strip Re(s) > 1 - eta (and ultimately Re(s) > 1/2) for zeta(s).

attack_B_dyadic_parity_and_cross_scale_c.weighted_norm_equivalence_formula: (1 - 2^{-1/2 - sigma}) ||Q_lambda||_sigma <= ||Q_{lambda,odd}||_sigma <= (1 + 2^{-1/2 - sigma}) ||Q_lambda||_sigma  for all sigma > -1/2 (including sigma = 0 where 1 - 2^{-1/2} = 0.292893... > 0).

Exact dyadic parity annihilation Q_{lambda,odd}(X) = Q_lambda(X) + 2^{-1/2} Q_lambda(X/2), convergent dyadic inversion, exact grade-interval energy identity on [Y, tau Y] with cross-scale correlation, bounded norm equivalence for all sigma > -1/2, and proof that |1 + 2^{-rho}| >= 1 - 2^{-beta} > 0 on Re(rho) = beta > 0.
precise_obstruction_to_subgate_tc043a_cl: 1. In Attack A, the bivariate coprime Dirichlet series D_lambda(u, v) = zeta(2u) zeta(2v) / (zeta(u) zeta(v) zeta(u+v)) has numerator zeta(2u) zeta(2v) and coprimality factor 1/zeta(u+v) evaluated at 2u, 2v, u+v in the Euler-product half-plane Re(w) > 1 whenever Re(u) = Re(v) = beta > 1/2, so neither factor can vanish at an off-critical conjugate pair (rho, conj(rho)) to cancel the poles of 1/(zeta(u) zeta(v)); moreover M[Q_lambda](z) has a genuine simple pole at z = 0 of residue Gamma(5/4)/(4 zeta(1/2)) = -0.1551682265... != 0. While the Separable Gaussian Decoupling Replacement Theorem bypasses the transition Euler-Maclaurin barrier and proves the unconditional global energy bound int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_lambda(X)|^2 dX/X << Y exp(-2 c_1 (log Y)^{3/5} (log log Y)^{-1/5}) <<_D Y (log Y)^{-D}, improving exp(-2 c_1 Phi(Y)) to the power saving Y^{-1 + eps} required by int_Y^{tau Y} |Q_lambda(X)|^2 dX/X <= C_eps Y^eps is equivalent via Mellin inversion to a zero-free strip Re(s) > 1 - eta (and ultimately Re(s) > 1/2) for zeta(s). 2. In Attack B, the dyadic parity operator 1 + 2^{-1/2} D_2 multiplies an off-critical mode X^{rho - 1/2} by 1 + 2^{-rho}, which satisfies 0 < 1 - 2^{-beta} <= |1 + 2^{-rho}| <= 1 + 2^{-beta} < 2 for all beta = Re(rho) > 0 and therefore is a bounded invertible multiplier that cannot annihilate an off-critical zero.
